articles.text: NEW YORK (AP) — A bogus rumor that President Donald Trump was considering a pause in tariffs briefly lifted markets Monday before the White House shot down the unfounded reports.

note: A false report that Trump was weighing a 90-day tariff pause moved markets on 7 Apr 2025; the White House called it fake news within ~30 minutes. Page shows "Updated 2:06 PM EDT, April 7, 2025".

headline: No Plan To Levy GST On UPI Transactions Over Rs 2,000: Finance Ministry

articles.title: No Plan To Levy GST On UPI Transactions Over Rs 2,000: Finance Ministry
articles.author: IANS
articles.text: The Finance Ministry on Friday made it clear that the government is not considering any proposal to levy Goods and Services Tax (GST) on UPI transactions over Rs 2,000.

note: Viral claim that the government would levy GST on UPI transactions above Rs 2,000; Finance Ministry called it false on 18 Apr 2025. This article is the denial carrying the claim, not the original claim.

headline: 'India continues to use more cash today than 8 years ago': Rahul Gandhi on demonetisation anniversary

articles.title: 'India continues to use more cash today than 8 years ago': Rahul Gandhi on demonetisation anniversary | India News - Times of India
articles.author: TOI News Desk
articles.text: On the eighth anniversary of demonetisation, Rahul Gandhi criticized the policy, stating it damaged MSMEs and the informal sector while failing to curb cash usage. He highlighted that cash as a percentage of GDP is higher now than before demonetisation, advocating for policies that support fair businesses.

note: Eighth-anniversary piece on the 8 Nov 2016 demonetisation, published 8 Nov 2024: eight years after the event.

headline: One Year after Silicon Valley Bank’s Collapse, Not Much Has Changed

articles.title: One Year after Silicon Valley Bank’s Collapse, Not Much Has Changed - Roosevelt Institute
articles.author: Emily DiVito
articles.text: March 10, 2024, marked the one-year anniversary of the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank (SVB), which set off a period of prolonged disquiet in the US financial system—one that, before it was over, saw the collapses of two more large financial institutions, Signature Bank and First Republic Bank (FRB).

note: One-year retrospective on the 10 Mar 2023 SVB failure (a bank_stress event), published 11 Mar 2024.

articles.title: Don't expect 'immediate relief' from the Federal Reserve's first rate cut in years, economist says. Here's why
articles.author: Jessica Dickler
articles.text: Key Points * The Federal Reserve is about to cut rates for the first time in four years. * For consumers strained by high borrowing costs, this policy shift is welcome news — although one rate cut won't deliver immediate relief, experts say.

articles.text: The Reserve Bank of India’s Monetary Policy Committee is expected to keep the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% at the end of its three-day meeting on Friday, as policymakers are widely seen nearing the end of the current easing cycle.
